audience: SEO specialists, marketers and researchers who need live Google results through Zenserp

useCases.title: See the top search results for a keyword
useCases.text: The AI runs a live search and reads organic results, ads, featured snippets and related questions. Each search spends one request of your quota.

useCases.title: Find local businesses with ratings and phones
useCases.text: The AI searches Google local results near a location and lists shops and cafes with address, rating, phone and coordinates. Each search spends one request.

useCases.title: Read the latest news about a topic
useCases.text: The AI searches Google News and lists title, source, date and snippet for each story. Each search spends one request of your quota.

useCases.title: Compare product prices across merchants
useCases.text: The AI searches Google Shopping for product, price, merchant and rating, then opens a product page to see the offers of all merchants.

useCases.title: Check what AI answer engines say about a brand
useCases.text: The AI sends a prompt to ChatGPT, Perplexity, Gemini or Copilot and reads the answer with citations. With a brand name it reports whether and where the brand was cited.

useCases.title: Check how many searches are left
useCases.text: The AI reads the remaining requests on the key's plan. This call spends no quota.
